name: dao-code
description: A terminal coding agent that turns DeepSeek-V4's cache economics into capability with trustworthy memory (re-verified against your code) and robust long tasks

name: openwiki
description: OpenWiki is a CLI that writes and maintains agent documentation for your codebase — generates structured context files so coding agents find the repo context they need without loading everything into one instruction file

name: orca
description: Orca is the ADE (Agent Development Environment) for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop and mobile.

name: astryx
description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready — built so coding agents can reason about your design tokens, component patterns, and visual constraints

name: headroom
description: Python context compression library that achieves 60-95% token reduction on tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM — available as a library, proxy, or MCP server

name: Senior-SWE-Bench
description: An open-source benchmark that assesses agents as senior engineers — 300 high-complexity GitHub issues requiring multi-file reasoning, architectural decision-making, and long-horizon planning

name: GLM-5.2
description: GLM-5.2: 744B MoE open-weights model (40B active params) with 1M context, MIT license — achieves 62.1 on SWE-bench Pro, beating GPT-5.5 (58.6) at 1/6th the API cost

name: box3d
description: Box3D is a 3D rigid body simulation library for games, built as the natural 3D extension of Box2D's constraint-based physics with the same minimal-dependency philosophy
